Hi Leny,
Thanks for reaching out. Would you like to come tonight at 18:45 for the inspection?
40 Rosa St, Spring Hill QLD 4000
Emilio will be there to assist you.
+61 481 517 377 (WhatsApp)
Hi! Thanks for the invite. As I mentioned, I’m actually still in France and won't be landing in Brisbane until March 25th.

Hi!
My name is Lény, I’m a 22-year-old French student, and I’ve just landed in Brisbane for a 6-month internship at QUT.
I’m currently staying in a hostel in the CBD and I'm looking for a place to settle in as soon as possible. Is the room in Fortitude Valley still available?
I’m a clean, easy-going, and respectful person with previous experience in shared houses, so I’m well-aware of the importance of keeping common areas tidy. When I’m not at my internship, I love exploring, cooking, and I’m really keen to discover the Aussie lifestyle!
I’m available for a viewing anytime this week since I’m already in town.
Looking forward to hearing from you!
Best, Lény
